segments.name: Podcast platform
segments.description: A podcast platform and publisher that produces and distributes advertiser-supported podcast content for listeners, talent and brand advertisers.
segments.evidence: The Company views its operations and manages its business in one segment, which is the business of being a leading podcast platform and publisher that makes its content available to audiences via all podcasting distribution platforms.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from advertising agencies and clients who pay for audio, video and social advertising impressions, plus a percentage split of advertising revenue shared with talent.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate revenue from the sale of audio, video and social advertising delivered through advertising impressions.

changes.text: In 2023, the company completed its spin-out from LiveOne and became a standalone publicly traded company on Nasdaq.
changes.evidence: On September 8, 2023, we completed our spin-out from LiveOne and our direct listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market (the "Spin-Out") and our shares of common stock began trading on the Nasdaq under the symbol of "PODC".
